title: MK-FluPipe NF: A reproducible DSL2 Nextflow workflow for Influenza short-read and long-read analysis
description: MK Flu-Pipe Nextflow is a Nextflow DSL2 pipeline for Influenza genome analysis, supporting short-read (Illumina) and long-read (ONT) sequencing data. It covers QC, host depletion, IRMA assembly, BLAST typing, Nextclade classification, iVar/Medaka variant calling, antiviral resistance, H5 virulence markers, coinfection analysis, and GISAID-ready surveillance outputs.
